name: storefront-webapp
description: The customer-facing storefront: a React SPA where a signed-in shopper browses the handmade-ceramics catalog, searches/filters products, manages a cart, checks out, and views their own order history. It holds no server-side state and no secrets — all catalog, cart, order, and payment logic lives behind ceramics-api. It does not expose any admin/catalog-management capability.

dependencies.name: ceramics-api
dependencies.description: Calls the Ceramics API for the product catalog, cart, checkout, and the shopper's own order history.

dependencies.name: user-auth
dependencies.description: Thunder-issued OIDC sign-in (PKCE) so a shopper can authenticate before browsing or checking out.
